description: This file contains the implementation of the HomeScreen composable for an Android TV application using Jetpack Compose. It displays a grid of matches with D-pad navigation support, including match cards with live status indicators.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that displays a grid of match cards with a header.

methods.name: MatchCard
methods.description: Private composable that renders an individual match card with focus scaling and click handling.

methods.name: MaterialTheme.typTypography
methods.description: Extension function to retrieve the titleLarge typography style.
